patthana14.21:1.1: sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.21:2.1: anārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana14.21:3.1: sārammaṇañca anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
